messages:
elaine-partnerships: Quick sync: we saw reproducible OOMs on MI300 eu-central during long-context evals (model: rebel-13b@v3, seq=8192). Appears to be KV cache growth. Need a short contingency: marketplace SKU fallback, SI test window, and customer communications before next week.

ken-eng: Can you share the minimal repro and the error text?

elaine-partnerships: Repro: rebel-13b@v3, seq_len=8192, batch=2, node mi300-eu-04. Log snippet: "ERROR: GPU OOM during KV-append at step 412".

sam-platform: Mitigation proposal: routing policy `mi300-eu-longseq-fallback` (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%) routing that model id to H100/H200 hosts in EU. Also push a non-breaking marketplace suggestion so EU customers see fallback SKUs.

jules-cloud: I'll draft the marketplace edit. Suggested mapping: rebel-13b -> eu: [H100-XL, H200-STD]. Hold until SI window confirmed.

vendor-mi300: Acknowledged. We can reproduce and are preparing a driver RC (binary) in ~48-72h. Short-term workaround: set `gpu_mem_guard=0.85` and avoid quantized images for canary runs.

vendor-gaudi: We will run extended long-seq parity tests on Gaudi if you share the exact commit/tag; no immediate regressions seen on our infra.

ken-eng: Also propose a runtime soft-fallback: if seq_len>4096 prefer H100-compatible kernel for rebel-13b model id (config toggle for fast rollback). Need perf & cost delta vs H100 for customer comms.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-410 created: "MI300 EU long-seq KV cache OOM". Runbook: internal link posted.

sam-platform: Action list: 1) open routing PR + canary plan, 2) marketplace draft (jules), 3) SI window request: Fri 02:00-08:00 UTC, 4) vendors provide RC & test reports, 5) ken to run perf/cost delta. Reconvene in 48h or after RC. :thumbsup:
